name: War Sun
text:
When you use this unit's BOMBARDMENT ability, you may roll against each planet in its system.

Hellfire: After rolling for this unit's BOMBARDMENT ability, you may discard this card to double all hits produced by this unit against 1 planet in that system.

Cost -2, Move +1

name: Flagship
text:
Slipspace Transfer: You may discard this card at the start of a round of combat to remove this unit from the board and place it in the active system.

Move +1

name: Dreadnought
text:
At the start of space combat, you may choose 1 of your units of this type to roll 1 die. On a result equal to or greater than that unit's BOMBARDMENT value, produce 1 hit.

Dyadic Jump Drive: After you activate a system, you may discard this card to apply +2 to the MOVE value of each unit of this type on the board that you control.

Capacity +1

name: Carrier
text:
While you are the active player, this unit may ignore the effects of anomalies.

Quantum Translocation: After you activate a system, you may discard this card to allow this unit to transport ground forces out of systems that contain your command tokens.

Combat +1

name: Cruiser
text:
This unit gains SPACE CANNON 8.

Slip-Link: After a player moves ships into this unit's system, you may discard this card to move up to 2 units of this type from adjacent systems into this unit's system.

Capacity +1

name: Destroyer
text:
During the Anti-Fighter Barrage step of a space combat in a system adjacent to this unit's system, you may use the ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE ability of 1 of your units of this type in this system.

Heat Seekers: After you roll for this unit's ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE ability, you may discard this card to reroll all misses.

Combat +1

name: The Ashen Hourglass
text: At the start of a round of space combat, you may exhaust this card and select a unit type controlled by your opponent participating in this combat. That unit type does not roll combat dice during this round of combat.

name: Hand of the Emperor
text: After an agenda is revealed, you may purge this card to immediately resolve that agenda as if you had placed 1 vote on the outcome of your choice.

name: The Silence
text: At the start of the strategy phase, you may purge this card and choose 1 strategy card. That strategy card must be chosen last.

name: Hamit's Treasure
text:
When you gain this card, place 5 trade goods from the supply on it; trade goods on this card can be spent as either resources or influence. At the start of a strategy phase, place 2 trade goods from the supply on this card.

Action: Purge this card to gain all trade goods on this card and the same amount from the supply.

name: The Wellspring
text:
When you gain this card, place the Libertalia planet token in a system that contains your ships and gain its planet card and legendary ability card.

Libertalia 2/2, Legendary, Cultural.

River of Paradise: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to choose 1 planet you control. Ready that planet and either repair each of your damaged mechs, or place 2 infantry on that planet.

name: The Ouroboros
text: When you purge another relic, gain 1 purged relic fragment. ACTION: Purge this card to ready up to 4 exhausted non-strategy card components.

name: Temporal Dissidence
text: When you would resolve the primary ability of one of your strategy cards, you may purge this card to resolve the primary ability of a readied or unchosen strategy card instead.
